verdict.rationale: Modal ships its own official CLI, which can be installed as a standalone tool and supports non-interactive flags like `--env`, plus a Python SDK for programmatically interacting with the platform. Both are first-party capabilities that enable headless automation. Nothing in the pack covers CI use specifically. Missing for 10: documented CI integration (e.g., GitHub Actions examples), non-interactive token/credential auth for CI runners, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The CLI can also be installed as a standalone tool via [uvx.sh](https://uvx.sh):
Most CLI commands also support an `--env` flag letting you specify which Environment you intend to interact with
The [Modal](https://modal.com/) Python SDK allows you to deploy high-performance serverless applications and programmatically interact with the Modal platform.
